g.text: MinVelRank6Convo1 begins.
MomToxicated: You know, I think I'm actually going to like it here.
Even if we never get answers about Rusalka?
Really? Why's that?
Check boolean MinVelTogether
MomToxicated: It's nice to have like-minded individuals around to talk to.
MomToxicated: I think you'll get the answers you need, in the end.
true
MomToxicated: Not every story has a happy ending, Drifter.
false
MomToxicated: The ladies here are quite something.
MomToxicated: And I can be at peace with that.
MomToxicated: And sometimes, that's okay.
MomToxicated: We're starting a book club.
MomToxicated: I just hope that... whatever she's become, whatever she really is -
MomToxicated: Without tears, we wouldn't know how to laugh.
MomToxicated: But even if we never get the answers we're looking for about Neci?
MomToxicated: Some part of her is still our little girl.
MomToxicated: Without death, life would have no meaning.
MomToxicated: And that part, however small it might be, finds her own peace.
MomToxicated: And without a yesterday, we wouldn't appreciate a new tomorrow.
PapaPolar: we raised her to be the best parts of both of us. tough. vicious. kind. resourceful.
Chat ends.
PapaPolar: but above all, she's a sols-damned *survivor*
PapaPolar: so when you do cross paths with whatever is wearing her face next?
PapaPolar: you tell her this, from us:
Update boolean VelimirEclipse
PapaPolar: "On empty crossroads, seek the eclipse."
Um. Okay. Noted.
What's... that supposed to mean?
MomToxicated: Also... thank you. For helping us remember why we really came here.
MomToxicated: We'd tell you, but then we'd have to kill you. ;)
MomToxicated: It was about finding something we'd lost, deep down.
MomToxicated: Not just Neci.
PapaPolar: but also each other.
PapaPolar: seriously. i never thought of myself as the retiring type.
PapaPolar: but here? with these lovable idiots?
PapaPolar: and my beautiful, *incredibly* sexy wife? hard to not be happy.
PapaPolar: yeah... neci's a grown woman. but whatever she is, whatever answers are out there...
PapaPolar: i think our part in that story ends here, lil buddy.
PapaPolar: and that's fine by us.
PapaPolar: you got this.
Update boolean MinervaVelimirBar
Chat ends. Next chat will be MinVelRusalka.
